summary: Full-stack development of a platform supporting a fiduciary purchasing agent for FF&E/OS&E procurement, for a US client.
highlights: Built and maintained full-stack features across the procurement platform.

Migrated existing quote data to the rebuilt platform and reconciled it against the legacy system, tracing a mismatch in financial totals to differing rounding behavior between JavaScript and the legacy system, and aligning the new calculations to the client's existing rounding rules — number continuity was an explicit client requirement.
